pretreatment: dipping into a HCl : H2O2 : H2O = 1 : 1 : 1000 mixed solution for 10 s, a NH3OH : H2O2 : H2O = 1: 1: 1000 mixed solution for 10 s, and subsequent dipping into a HF : H2O = 1 : 20 solution for 10 s at room temperature
surface_functionalization: covered by a 1000 A thick SiO2 film deposited by the CVD method using SiH4 and O2 at 250°C
evidence: The samples were of single-crystal Ge(100) wafers 0.35 mm thick, and n-type (b-doped) with a resistivity of p = 0.2-0.4 R cm. The samples were chemically cleaned by dipping into a HCl : H2O2 : H2O = 1 : 1 : 1000 mixed solution for 10 s, a NH3OH : H2O2 : H2O = 1: 1: 1000 mixed solution for 10 s, and subsequent dipping into a HF : H2O = 1 : 20 solution for 10 s at room temperature. Then its surface was covered by a 1000 A thick SiO2 film deposited by the CVD method using SiH4 and O2 at 250°C.
